estimate_basis: Dense completion to the assumed pallet rear; working assumption of one missing concealed carton. Conditional model estimate, not a measured inventory or statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: Rectangular cartons with fitted, variable widths and column-wise depths
Unseen columns densely filled to the pallet rear
One concealed carton missing for the working estimate
Rigid cartons with centred contents; static gravity, no crushing or handling acceleration
